features.heartbeat: 30s foreground only, one timer per session, ignores stale account results/errors
features.patch: Native RCP adapter for API24; ordinary HTTP transport has no PATCH until API26
features.managerAssist: Explicit consent; brief only text/facts, per-repair optional first 3 images default false; read-only advice/evidence
features.studentVisits: Structured Beijing +08:00 time window; editing/confirmation separated by role
features.aiRetry: AI_UNAVAILABLE / AI_REQUEST_FAILED / AI_RESULT_UNKNOWN release local key for a next explicit user attempt; NETWORK / AI_REQUEST_RUNNING / unconfigured retain it; no automatic retry.

features.singleFlight: Manual, view poll and heartbeat follow-up board GETs share one RequestFlight per login epoch; stale epoch cannot clear current request
features.networkRecovery: A successful accepted board for the current account clears the prior error, including non-offline HTTP failures; wrong-account and older-revision results do not.
